answer: Proposed: delta, canyon and garden irrigation share one voting budget. A fixed council delegates 100 units/day total, with no signup grants. Each voting key consumes at least 1. Validators check signed transfers and ledger debits; invalid or reused units yield no vote. Weight equals units consumed: ten 10-unit keys equal one 100-unit key, even on shared hardware in parallel. Quota renews daily; its cost is lost allocation elsewhere, not a fee or locked stake. Hardware is reusable. Council capture can redirect all 100 votes; aliases alone cannot multiply weight.
